question: When industry labels are backfilled, how many securities' 357/471 values change -- as opposed to how many rows are merely added?
why_it_is_not_just_the_added_rows: both factors are group statistics. AttentionSpilloverCalculator computes a leave-one-out peer mean within industry x market-cap tercile, so (sum(G) - a_i)/(|G|-1) - a_i changes for EVERY member of G when G's membership changes. 行业内收益标准化绝对值 standardises within industry and behaves the same way.
